# gpui-pre 0.3.12

This copy of Zed's GPUI is based on the gpui-pre 0.3.12 source package on
crates.io and licensed under [Apache-2.0](LICENSE-APACHE).

The fuzukue contributors modified the manifest and patched input dispatch,
gesture handling, list and div layout, text layout, and window behavior.
The source distribution omits upstream example media with separate or
unconfirmed terms, including the CC BY-SA dragon SVG, and removes the
dependent example targets. The EXIF regression test uses a locally generated
JPEG with black and white halves and EXIF orientation 3.
